note: Self-reported / crowdsourced usage observations read off the provider's own usage screen (claude.ai, ChatGPT, Claude Code, etc.). These are REAL observed data points about chat-subscription caps that no API exposes: what a plan actually allowed before it throttled, or the usage screen's reading at a moment in time. Each report records what was seen, not an inferred cap. Empty until the first reading is added; the site hides the section while empty. Add a report by appending an object to `reports`.

fields.surface: where it was read: claude.ai | desktop | Claude Code | chatgpt.com
fields.window: the cap window this observes: 5h | week | day | month
fields.captured_at: ISO timestamp when the reading was taken
fields.reset_at: ISO timestamp the window resets (optional, if shown)
fields.metric: what the number means: messages | percent | tokens
fields.observed: numeric value of metric at capture (e.g. messages sent before the cap, or % used)
fields.limit_hit: true if this reading is the point the cap actually throttled
fields.note: verbatim wording from the usage screen + any context
fields.usage_tokens: optional {input, output, cache_write, cache_read} token counts for the session
fields.api_equiv_usd: optional number: what this usage would cost at the model's API rate (a value comparison, not the cap)
fields.api_equiv_basis: optional string documenting the pricing used for api_equiv_usd

reports.note: Single continuous session from 0% at window start. 385 Opus turns over ~1h02m reached 75% of the 5h cap (in-app indicator; may lag a few min). Session token usage: 283,476 output + 36,742 fresh input + 3,341,442 cache-write + 50,597,493 cache-read tokens. Priced at the Opus 4.8 API rate (input $5, output $25, 5-min cache-write $6.25, cache-read $0.50 per 1M), that is ~$53 of API-equivalent value for 75% of the window, implying ~$71 of API-equivalent Opus usage per full 5h window on a $20/mo Pro plan. (API-equivalent is a value comparison; the actual cap mechanic is not published.)
reports.api_equiv_basis: Opus 4.8 API rate: input $5, output $25, 5-min cache-write $6.25, cache-read $0.50 per 1M tokens. Value comparison, not the cap mechanic.
reports.evidence: Claude Code session transcript + in-app 5h usage indicator

reports.note: $20 Pro plan, weekly cap at 78% (in-app indicator). MEASURED FLOOR from local Claude Code transcripts (~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl), deduped by message.id, for the active weekly window. SCOPED to one account's projects, because this machine also ran a SECOND $20 Pro login this week whose Claude Code burn hits a different account's cap. Attribution is a weak proxy: Claude Code's login is global per instance, not per project, so a session could have run on either login; transcripts record no account identity. Also excludes claude.ai web/desktop chat, which counts against this same cap. So the figure is a soft lower bound. 1,627 assistant turns: Opus 4.8 ($117), Sonnet 4.6 ($35), Haiku 4.5 ($0.41). At Anthropic API list rates that is ~$153 of API-equivalent value at 78%, implying a full weekly Claude Code budget of >=~$197 API-equivalent on a $20/mo Pro plan. (API-equivalent is a value comparison; the cap mechanic is not published.)
reports.api_equiv_basis: Anthropic API list price per model (Opus 4.8 in $5 / out $25 / cw-5m $6.25 / cw-1h $10 / cr $0.50; Sonnet 4.6 $3/$15/$3.75/$6/$0.30; Haiku 4.5 $1/$5/$1.25/$2/$0.10 per 1M). See scripts/cc-usage.mjs. Value comparison, not the cap mechanic.
reports.evidence: Aggregated ~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl assistant-turn usage via scripts/cc-usage.mjs, deduped by message.id. Paired with in-app weekly % indicator. Scoped to one account's projects as a weak account proxy (see note).

reports.note: A SECOND $20 Pro login on the same machine, read off the in-app Plan-usage panel: weekly 'all models' 79%, resets in ~1 day (exact reset time not shown). Same panel showed the 5-hour limit at 7% (resets ~4h) and a usage-credits pool at $0.00 of $40.00. Recorded as an OBSERVED-ONLY receipt: no measured-burn pairing, because (1) this machine ran two Claude logins this week and transcripts carry no account identity, and (2) this weekly window's reset time was unknown at capture, so per-account burn couldn't be scoped to the right window. The observed % is a real reading; any $ figure would be a guess on a guess.
reports.evidence: In-app Claude Code Plan-usage panel screenshot: 5-hour 7% resets 4h; Weekly all models 79% resets 1d; usage credits $0.00 of $40.00; context 82.5k/1.0M.

reports.note: $20 Pro plan, SECOND weekly point ~1h after the 78% reading above (~$153 floor). Single-account-scoped Claude Code burn, deduped by message.id, over the active weekly window; same weak-account-proxy + claude.ai-excluded caveats as that row. CAP-SHAPE SIGNAL: the two points imply ~$196/week (78% -> $153) and ~$201/week (83% -> $167) API-equivalent — consistent to within ~3%, which suggests a roughly LINEAR / token-based weekly cap rather than a dollar-weighted one that would bend. RESET AMBIGUITY (unresolved): the in-app panel showed 'Weekly all models 83% resets 1d', i.e. ~1 day out, but the reset was believed to be ~2 days out; the window anchor is therefore in question, so the absolute /week figure is provisional. The cross-point ratio is the stronger evidence because it is less sensitive to the exact anchor.

reports.evidence: scripts/cc-usage.mjs (auto scope + weekly-reset anchor), deduped by message.id. In-app panel: 5-hour 47% resets 3h; Weekly all models 83% resets 1d; credits $0.00/$40.00; context 163.7k/1.0M.

reports.note: $20 Pro plan, 5-hour limit at 47%. User-confirmed this was the ONLY Claude Code session active in the current 5h window (single continuous session, single project, all Opus 4.8), so there is no cross-session contamination. The weakness here is the ROLLING window start: the panel said 'resets 3h', implying the 5h window opened ~2h ago, over which this session burned ~$25 API-equivalent (-> implied ~$53 per full 5h). But the exact open minute is unknown and the burn roughly doubles between a 2h and 3h lookback (~$25 vs ~$55), so the true implied full-5h value spans ~$53-117. Recorded as a FLOOR at the 2h-lookback figure. Compare the earlier clean 5h receipt (75% -> ~$71 per 5h); both are in the same rough band.
reports.api_equiv_basis: Anthropic API list price, Opus 4.8 (in $5 / out $25 / cw-1h $10 / cr $0.50 per 1M). Value comparison, not the cap mechanic.
reports.evidence: scripts/cc-usage.mjs --since <now-2h> (only ai-limit-tracker present, confirming a single in-window session). In-app panel: 5-hour 47% resets 3h.

reports.note: $20 Pro plan, 5-hour limit MAXED OUT (cap hit, user-reported). Cleanest 5h point yet: one continuous Claude Code session, single project, all Opus 4.8 — no cross-session or cross-account ambiguity. A contiguous burst of 450 assistant turns over ~3.5h filled the window. Measured Claude Code burn to the cap-hit was ~$69 API-equivalent at list rates. Because the cap was actually HIT (cumulative = 100%), this $69 is a hard LOWER BOUND on the full 5h ceiling: it counts Claude Code transcript burn only, so any claude.ai chat in the window would sit on top. So the 5h cap is >=~$69 API-equiv. This corroborates the earlier partial reading (75% -> ~$71/5h): the 5h ceiling clusters around ~$69-71 API-equivalent on a $20/mo Pro plan. (API-equivalent is a value comparison; the cap mechanic is not published.)
reports.api_equiv_basis: Anthropic API list price, Opus 4.8 (in $5 / out $25 / cw-1h $10 / cr $0.50 per 1M). Value comparison, not the cap mechanic.
reports.evidence: scripts/cc-usage.mjs aggregation of one project's transcript for the maxed window (span 2026-06-08T10:49:17Z..14:19:19Z, 450 turns, deduped by message.id). In-app 5-hour indicator hit 100% (throttled).
